name: Banana Oat Cookies
ingredients_raw: Multigrain Flour Blend (49%) [Whole Wheat, Jowar, Oat], Rice Bran Oil (12%), Jaggery (11%), Unrefined Sugar (11%), Instant Oat (3%), Banana Fruit Powder (2%), Skimmed Milk Powder, Corn Flour, Nature - identical Flavours, Raising Agent (Baking Soda), Natural Emulsifier (Sunflower Lecithin), Salt, Xanthan Gum, Antioxidant (Natural Rosemary). Allergen Note: Contains Milk, Wheat & Oat. Processed in a factory that also processes nuts.
